FAQs

1. What makes Filo different from other tutoring apps?
Filo is the world’s fastest and most advanced learning platform that combines real tutors and AI-powered solutions to make learning instant, personalized, and effective. Unlike other tutoring apps,Filo lets students connect with an expert tutor in under 60 seconds or get instant answers through Filo SuperAI, which provides 3× better accuracy, step-by-step explanations, and natural writing formats for assignments and exam questions. Filo caters to K–12 students, college learners, and government exam aspirants, ensuring every learner gets the right kind of help whenever they need it. Trusted by over 5 million students across 60+ countries and recognized by Google and Amazon for its innovation.
2. How fast can I get help on Filo?
With Filo, you can get help instantly! Whether it’s through Filo SuperAI, which gives answers in seconds, or live instant tutoring that connects you with an expert in under 60 seconds, Filo ensures you never stay stuck on a question for long.
3. Is Filo useful for college students too?
Yes! Filo is super helpful its SuperAI to college students which helps college students instantly solve assignments and prepare for exams with 3× higher accuracy than ChatGPT and Gemini and also the "Natural Writing" mode — delivering smart, ready-to-use answers in the exact format students need.
4. What is Filo SuperAI ?
Filo SuperAI is an AI-powered study assistant that provides instant, step-by-step answers with 3× higher accuracy and a natural writing style — just like a real tutor.It helps students quickly solve homework, assignments, and exam questions across school, college, and competitive exams, making learning faster and easier.
5. Is Filo powered by AI?
Yes! Filo is powered by advanced AI technology that makes learning faster and more personalized.With Filo SuperAI, students get instant, accurate, and step-by-step solutions to questions, along with natural explanations written just like a real tutor.
6. What is Filo ?
Filo is the world’s fastest 1-to-1 tutoring and learning platform that connects students with expert tutors in under 60 seconds for a live video session.Trusted by over 5 million students across 60+ countries, Filo offers instant academic help, AI-powered learning support, and structured private courses for learners at every stage — from K-12 and college students to aspirants for government exams preparing for exams like SSC, Banking, and Railways. With innovations like Filo SuperAI, Private Courses, and 24×7 Instant live tutoring, Filo combines real tutors and intelligent AI to make learning personal, fast, and accessible — anytime, anywhere.Recognized and awarded by Google and Amazon for its innovation in education, Filo continues to redefine how students learn and get help across the world.
7. What is Filo's Instant tutoring?
Filo’s Instant Tutoring connects students with a qualified tutor in under 60 seconds for a 1-to-1 live video session — anytime, anywhere, even on a saturday 2 A.M .Whether you’re stuck on a homework question, need last-minute exam help, or want to understand a tough concept, simply upload your question or take a photo — and within seconds,Filo will match you with the best available tutor for that topic. With 24×7 availability, and expert tutors from top institutions, Filo ensures that students get real-time, personalized learning support exactly when they need it most.
8. What is Filo's private courses?
Filo’s Private Courses are personalized, goal-based learning programs designed to help students master subjects or prepare for specific exams with dedicated expert tutors.Unlike instant sessions, Private Courses follow a structured plan — including regular classes, progress tracking, assignments, and doubt-clearing — tailored to each student’s learning goals.Available for K-12 subjects, college courses, and competitive exams like JEE, NEET, SSC, Banking, and Railways, these courses combine live 1-on-1 sessions, AI-powered learning tools, and continuous mentor support to deliver a complete, results-driven learning experience.
9. Can I use Filo for my College Assignments and Exam help?
Yes! ofcourse, Filo offers its SuperAI to college students which helps college students instantly solve assignments and prepare for exams with 3× higher accuracy than ChatGPT and Gemini and also the "Natural Writing" mode — delivering smart, ready-to-use answers in the exact format students need.
